name: edit_my_site
description: Jena proposes a small change to her own website (text or CSS, find → replace in src/*.js|css or index.html). Before proposing she looks it up in her library and runs her own roast_critique on the new code; then her site-edit checker puts it on its own git branch, runs parse + lint + build + a headless smoke test vs main (desktop, phone 390 px, OBS) and pushes ONLY a passing branch for a Vercel preview. She can never merge: mama approves (or discards / rolls back) in the dev panel.

example.text: jena edit your site: change "talk to Jena…" to "say hi to Jena…" because it sounds friendlier
